description:
The terminal keeps launch errors visible. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-launch-error; the page's terminal websockets that launch a command ask the server for a terminal session that doesn't exist, so the launch fails. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). 
1. Navigate to /c/term-launch-error. Send "!" (fill [data-testid="message-input"] with it and click [data-testid="send-button"]). There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-error".
2. Choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input". The message input's value should contain "Error:".
